cumleler: How can a reflex reveal rapidly growing loudness?
Normally the reflex appears about seventy to a hundred decibels above threshold.
The Metz test looks at this gap between the two thresholds.
A gap of sixty decibels or less suggests recruitment.
Loudness may be growing rapidly above threshold.
But the test alone is not definitive; the battery is read together.
